summary.text: Maureen Dower is the Democratic candidate for the Colorado House of Representatives, District 64, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A veterinarian, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she was elected a Berthoud town trustee in 2018 and served as Mayor Pro Tem.

paragraphs.text: Maureen Dower earned a bachelor's degree from Pennsylvania State University in 1990 and a graduate degree from Purdue University in 1995, according to Ballotpedia.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up in semi-rural Pennsylvania, earned a B.S. in Animal Science from Penn State and a Doctor of Veterinary Medicine degree from Purdue, and started a mobile veterinary practice in Colorado in 1996.
She later became a technical services veterinarian for Zoetis.
As a Berthoud trustee, she said, she helped update town development codes and pass voter-approved dedicated funding for parks, recreation and trails.
Dower advanced from the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary.
Her survey lists attainable housing, sustainable water use, and wages and pathways to prosperity as her key messages.
